theorem mvcc.api.sent.fgsOf_prefix {l l' : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv} (hp : l <+: l') (fg : GName) : fg
    ∈ mvcc.api.sent.fgsOf l → fg ∈ mvcc.api.sent.fgsOf l'

def mvcc.api.sent.fgsOf (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) : List GName :=
  List.flatMap mvcc.api.sent.SEv.fgs l

theorem mvcc.api.sent.replay_F_prefix (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) {l l' : List
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv} (hp : l <+: l') : (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).F <+: (mvcc.api.sent.replay
    dec l').F

def mvcc.api.sent.nsCount : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv → Nat :=
  List.brecOn x✝ mvcc.api.sent.nsCount._f

theorem mvcc.api.sent.nsCount.eq_def (x✝ : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) : mvcc.api.sent.nsCount x✝ =
    match x✝ with | [] => 0 | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.send r fg rg lo L c0 cov dead :: l =>
    mvcc.api.sent.nsCount l | head :: l => mvcc.api.sent.nsCount l + 1

theorem mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf_prefix {l l' : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv} (hp : l <+: l') :
    mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf l <+: mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf l'

theorem mvcc.api.sent.step_cancel (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (st : mvcc.api.sent.RState)
    (id : w64) : mvcc.api.sent.RState.step dec st (mvcc.api.sent.SEv.cancel id) = { S := st.S.cancel
    id, D := if (st.S.ws !! id).isSome = true then id :: st.D else st.D, F := st.F }

inductive mvcc.api.sent.SEv : Type
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg (id : w64) (rg : mvcc.WatchRange) (fg : GName) (lo : Nat) :
      mvcc.api.sent.SEv
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.cancel (id : w64) : mvcc.api.sent.SEv
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.close : mvcc.api.sent.SEv
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.send (r : mvcc.api.WResp) (fg : GName) (rg : mvcc.WatchRange) (lo : Nat) (L :
      mvcc.Log) (c0 : Int) (cov : List mvcc.api.sent.CovRec) (dead : List w64) : mvcc.api.sent.SEv

def mvcc.api.sent.SEv.countable : Pos.Countable mvcc.api.sent.SEv :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun e => Pos.Countable.encode e.code) mvcc.api.sent.SEv.countable._proof_6

theorem mvcc.api.sent.LogWF_snoc (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv)
    (e : mvcc.api.sent.SEv) : mvcc.api.sent.LogWF dec (l ++ [e]) ↔ mvcc.api.sent.LogWF dec l ∧
    mvcc.api.sent.stepOk dec (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l) e

theorem mvcc.api.sent.nsCount_append (l t : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) : mvcc.api.sent.nsCount (l ++ t)
    = mvcc.api.sent.nsCount l + mvcc.api.sent.nsCount t

theorem mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf_eq (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv)
    : mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf l = List.map mvcc.api.sent.SentFact.r (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).F

def mvcc.api.sent.LogWF (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) : Prop
    :=
  ∀ (p : Nat) (e : mvcc.api.sent.SEv),
    l[p]? = some e → mvcc.api.sent.stepOk dec (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec (List.take p l)) e

theorem mvcc.api.sent.replay_F_snoc (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (l : List
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (e : mvcc.api.sent.SEv) : ∃ t, (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec (l ++ [e])).F =
    (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).F ++ t

theorem mvcc.api.sent.replay_snoc (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (l : List
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (e : mvcc.api.sent.SEv) : mvcc.api.sent.replay dec (l ++ [e]) =
    mvcc.api.sent.RState.step dec (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l) e

def mvcc.api.sent.SEv.code : mvcc.api.sent.SEv → w64 × mvcc.WatchRange × GName × Nat ⊕ w64 ⊕ Unit ⊕
    mvcc.api.WResp × GName × mvcc.WatchRange × Nat × mvcc.Log × Int × List mvcc.api.sent.CovRec ×
    List w64 :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg id rg fg lo => Sum.inl (id, rg, fg, lo)
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.cancel id => Sum.inr (Sum.inl id)
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.close => Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl ()))
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.send r fg rg lo L c0 cov dead => Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (r, fg, rg, lo, L, c0, cov, dead)))

theorem mvcc.api.sent.fgsOf_append (l t : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) : mvcc.api.sent.fgsOf (l ++ t) =
    mvcc.api.sent.fgsOf l ++ mvcc.api.sent.fgsOf t

def mvcc.api.sent.stepOk (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (st : mvcc.api.sent.RState) :
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv → Prop :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg id rg fg lo => st.S.ws !! id = none ∧ id ≠ W64 (-1)
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.cancel id => True
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.close => True
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.send r fg rg lo L c0 cov dead =>
    have f := mvcc.api.sent.sendFact dec r fg rg lo L c0 cov dead;
    mvcc.api.sent.SentFact.holds (List.map mvcc.api.sent.SentFact.r st.F) f ∧
      mvcc.api.sent.factAgree st.S f ∧ (∀ (id : w64), id ∈ f.dead → id ∈ st.D) ∧ mvcc.api.sent.stampsAt st.S st.F.length f

def mvcc.api.sent.rStart : mvcc.api.sent.RState :=
  { S := mvcc.api.wsStart, D := [], F := [] }

def mvcc.api.sent.SEv.fgs : mvcc.api.sent.SEv → List GName :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg id rg fg lo => [fg]
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.send r fg rg lo L c0 cov dead => fg :: List.map (fun x => x.snd.snd.fst) cov
  | x => []

theorem mvcc.api.sent.replay_congr (dec dec' : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (l : List
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (h : ∀ (fg : GName), fg ∈ mvcc.api.sent.fgsOf l → dec fg = dec' fg) :
    mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l = mvcc.api.sent.replay dec' l

theorem mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf_append (l t : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) : mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf (l ++ t)
    = mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf l ++ mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf t

def mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv → List mvcc.api.WResp :=
  List.brecOn x✝ mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf._f

def mvcc.api.sent.WResp.countable : Pos.Countable mvcc.api.WResp :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun r => Pos.Countable.encode (r.id, r.evs, r.rev, r.compactRev))
    mvcc.api.sent.WResp.countable._proof_1

theorem mvcc.api.sent.replay_ws_reg (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (l : List
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (id : w64) (w : mvcc.api.WInfo) (h : (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).S.ws !! id
    = some w) : ∃ rg fg lo, mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg id rg fg lo ∈ l

def mvcc.api.sent.CovRec : Type :=
  w64 × mvcc.WatchRange × GName × Nat

theorem mvcc.api.sent.step_reg (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (st : mvcc.api.sent.RState)
    (id : w64) (rg : mvcc.WatchRange) (fg : GName) (lo : Nat) : mvcc.api.sent.RState.step dec st
    (mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg id rg fg lo) = { S := st.S.register id { rg := rg, fs := dec fg, lo :=
    lo, k := st.F.length, live := true }, D := st.D, F := st.F }

def mvcc.api.sent.RState.step (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (st : mvcc.api.sent.RState) :
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv → mvcc.api.sent.RState :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg id rg fg lo =>
    { S := st.S.register id { rg := rg, fs := dec fg, lo := lo, k := st.F.length, live := true }, D := st.D, F := st.F }
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.cancel id =>
    { S := st.S.cancel id, D := if (st.S.ws !! id).isSome = true then id :: st.D else st.D, F := st.F }
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.close => { S := st.S.close, D := st.D, F := st.F }
  | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.send r fg rg lo L c0 cov dead =>
    { S := st.S, D := st.D, F := st.F ++ [mvcc.api.sent.sendFact dec r fg rg lo L c0 cov dead] }

structure mvcc.api.sent.RState : Type where
  S : mvcc.api.StreamState
  D : List w64
  F : List mvcc.api.sent.SentFact

theorem mvcc.api.sent.step_close (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (st : mvcc.api.sent.RState)
    : mvcc.api.sent.RState.step dec st mvcc.api.sent.SEv.close = { S := st.S.close, D := st.D, F :=
    st.F }

theorem mvcc.api.sent.replay_D_mono (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (l t : List
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (id : w64) : id ∈ (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).D → id ∈ (mvcc.api.sent.replay
    dec (l ++ t)).D

theorem mvcc.api.sent.sentInv_of_log (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool))
    (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (hwf : mvcc.api.sent.LogWF dec l) (hlb : mvcc.api.sent.lbsOk σ
    (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).F) : mvcc.api.sent.SentInv σ (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).S
    (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).D (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).F

def mvcc.api.sent.sendFact (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (r : mvcc.api.WResp) (fg : GName)
    (rg : mvcc.WatchRange) (lo : Nat) (L : mvcc.Log) (c0 : Int) (cov : List mvcc.api.sent.CovRec)
    (dead : List w64) : mvcc.api.sent.SentFact :=
  { r := r, rg := rg, fs := dec fg, lo := lo, L := L, c0 := c0,
    cov := List.map (fun c => { id := c.fst, rg := c.snd.fst, fs := dec c.snd.snd.fst, lo := c.snd.snd.snd }) cov,
    dead := dead }

theorem mvcc.api.sent.replay_reg (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv)
    (hwf : mvcc.api.sent.LogWF dec l) (id : w64) (rg : mvcc.WatchRange) (fg : GName) (lo : Nat) (hm
    : mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg id rg fg lo ∈ l) : mvcc.api.sent.regAgree (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).S
    id rg (dec fg) lo

theorem mvcc.api.sent.step_send (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (st : mvcc.api.sent.RState)
    (r : mvcc.api.WResp) (fg : GName) (rg : mvcc.WatchRange) (lo : Nat) (L : mvcc.Log) (c0 : Int)
    (cov : List mvcc.api.sent.CovRec) (dead : List w64) : mvcc.api.sent.RState.step dec st
    (mvcc.api.sent.SEv.send r fg rg lo L c0 cov dead) = { S := st.S, D := st.D, F := st.F ++
    [mvcc.api.sent.sendFact dec r fg rg lo L c0 cov dead] }

theorem mvcc.api.sent.LogWF_prefix (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) {l l' : List
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv} (hp : l <+: l') (h : mvcc.api.sent.LogWF dec l') : mvcc.api.sent.LogWF dec l

theorem mvcc.api.sent.replay_sends (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (l t : List
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (h : mvcc.api.sent.nsCount t = 0) : (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec (l ++ t)).S =
    (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).S ∧ (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec (l ++ t)).D = (mvcc.api.sent.replay
    dec l).D

def mvcc.api.sent.replay (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) :
    mvcc.api.sent.RState :=
  List.foldl (mvcc.api.sent.RState.step dec) mvcc.api.sent.rStart l

theorem mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf.eq_def (x✝ : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) : mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf x✝ =
    match x✝ with | [] => [] | mvcc.api.sent.SEv.send r fg rg lo L c0 cov dead :: l => r ::
    mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf l | head :: l => mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf l

theorem mvcc.api.sent.replay_cancel (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (l1 l : List
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (hwf : mvcc.api.sent.LogWF dec l) (id : w64) (rg : mvcc.WatchRange) (fg :
    GName) (lo : Nat) (hp : l1 ++ [mvcc.api.sent.SEv.cancel id] <+: l) (hreg : mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg
    id rg fg lo ∈ l1) : id ∈ (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).D

theorem mvcc.api.sent.replay_ws_isSome (dec dec' : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (l : List
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (i : w64) : ((mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).S.ws !! i).isSome =
    ((mvcc.api.sent.replay dec' l).S.ws !! i).isSome

theorem mvcc.api.sent.wsRecvOk_of_log (σ : mvcc.api.MvccState) (dec : GName → List (mvcc.EvM →
    Bool)) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (rs : List mvcc.api.WResp) (hwf : mvcc.api.sent.LogWF dec l)
    (hlb : mvcc.api.sent.lbsOk σ (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).F) (hrs : rs <+: mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf
    l) : mvcc.api.wsRecvOk σ (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).S rs
